hero_subhead: Boiler broken down in winter? H20 gets you warm again fast. Same-day repair service across Sunderland and surrounding areas.
services_heading: Complete Heating Solutions for Sunderland Homes
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full system installations, we handle every aspect of your central heating needs.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repairs
services.desc: Boiler stopped working? We diagnose and repair most faults the same day. Our engineers carry common parts on the van to get you back to comfort quickly.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted by Gas Safe engineers with a 10-year warranty. We install efficient condensing models that lower your heating bills.

services.title: Central Heating System Upgrades
services.desc: Replace old radiators, thermostats, and pipework. Modern systems heat your home faster and use less fuel, cutting energy costs by up to 30%.

services.title: Annual Boiler Servicing
services.desc: Keep your boiler safe and efficient with a yearly health check. We spot problems early, prevent breakdowns, and maintain your warranty.

services.title: Radiator Repair & Bleeding
services.desc: Cold spots on radiators? We remove air pockets, repair leaks, and balance your system so every room heats evenly.

services.title: Powerflush & System Cleaning
services.desc: Sludge in your heating pipes slows heat flow and damages your boiler. A powerflush clears blockages and restores full system performance.

about_pullquote: We treat your home's heating like it's our own—no shortcuts, no hidden charges.
about_para_1: H20 Plumbing and Heating was founded in 2006 with a simple mission: give Sunderland homeowners honest, reliable central heating service at fair prices. Over 18 years, we've installed and repaired thousands of boilers and heating systems across the city and surrounding villages. Every engineer is Gas Safe Registered and fully trained on the latest heating technology.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on speed and integrity. When a customer calls with a frozen boiler in winter, we aim to arrive within the hour—because we know heating emergencies don't follow business hours. Repeat customers make up more than 60% of our work, and we're proud that families trust us with their comfort year after year.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About H20

reviews.text: Boiler completely packed in just before Christmas. Called H20 at 9am and they were here by 10.30am same day. Fixed it by lunchtime. The bloke was polite, explained what was wrong, and the bill was fair. Saved us from a cold house. Will use them again without question.
reviews.author: Michael D.

reviews.text: Had a new boiler installed last month. Very professional from start to finish. They explained the whole system, gave me a clear quote upfront with no surprises, and installed it in a single day. Heating bills are noticeably lower now. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire T.

reviews.text: Service call for a radiator leak. Engineer arrived on time, found the problem straight away, fixed it and cleaned up after himself. No faffing about. Good price for the work. Definitely calling them next time I need the boiler serviced.
reviews.author: James P.
